{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''Just someone who's been stuck on Lok for too long, but you can call me Choster.|A spacer and Choster|<ref name="SWG:SwC" />}}
'''Choster''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a sister, [[Sheeli]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|After I set up their systems, the Sulfur morons decided that it would be easier, and maybe safer, to kill me instead of pay me. I barely escaped their bloodthirsty veermok with my life.  I had to change my name and find an image designer to give me a new face. But I don't forget or forgive being betrayed. I came back here to hide on Lok, waiting for a chance to repay them.|Choster, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwC" />}}
In his youth Choster tried to make a fortune by forging famous [[Holopainting/Legends|holopaintings]]. He wasn't very successful, but learned basic facts about the color spectrum. Years later he got stranded on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where he was befriended by a drunk [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. From him, Choster learned a lot of Tatooine-themed jokes that he later transferred into the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] of a security system he created.<ref name="SWG:SwC" />

Choster later traveled to the desert planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], where he was hired by the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] realized they had foolishly named themselves after the [[Sulfur Lake|lake]] where they had situated their "[[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hidden lair]]." In light of this, Choster was tasked with boosting their defenses around the base, after numerous enemies had deduced their location. After Choster established the security systems, the pirates decided it would be easier or safer to merely [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, rather than pay him. Choster barely escaped, and was forced to change his name and find an [[Image Designer|image designer]] to change his appearance.<ref name="SWG:SwC" />

Some time later, a retired Choster came back to [[Nym's Stronghold]], where he found solace in passing his time at the local [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]]. Eventually, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], the leader of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], sought out Choster, asking him for information concerning the lair's defenses. Choster gladly helped out the spacer, by providing him with essential information regarding how to bypass the security system.<ref name="SWG:SwC" /> With this information, a group of spacers working for the Lok Revenants successfully raided the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout.<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref>

Eventually, Nym attempted to broker a peace between the Lok Revenants and the Sulfur Lake Pirates. The pirates agreed, only under the condition that they hand over Choster. The pirates threatened that if the spacer and Nym did not hand over Choster, they would kill his sister [[Sheeli]] instead, whom they had in captivity. After a fierce battle between a group of spacers and the Sulfur Lake Pirates, it was eventually agreed that Choster's sister could be released, and Choster himself would not need to be handed over.<ref name="SWG:NP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Negotiate Peace|Lok}}</ref> However, a peace between the two factions would not occur any time soon.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Envoy|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Choster was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P3">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Choster was added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:P3" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> Choster's species used to be randomly generated,<ref name="SWG:P3" /> but his appearance was permanently set to be that of a male Rutian Twi'lek<ref name="SWG:SwC" /> after Nym's Theme Park was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]" on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
